title: The first fix check on a round-3 record cannot carry a lane-written net value that clears a negative round 3
why: On main, the first fix check on a round-3 record may carry any --net-value, so one lane-written "zero" clears a negative round 3, against decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3. Found by PR #1808's round 1 (coordinator, 01:05 CST Nov 8).
note: Built as a follow-up PR after #1808, in lane fail-record-ancestor-head (session_013NEJKzYhDtNPLcEdeVFEVe). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 01:06 CST Nov 8.
